verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a coding agent, but nothing in the evidence shows Devin's own source (cloud agent, CLI, or Desktop) is published under an open license. The only open-source mention is the separate Devin Handoff plugin for other agents, and AGENTS.md support is adoption of an open standard; both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
